1.why: All screens use a clean sans-serif typeface with comfortable line spacing and well-separated elements, though letter spacing appears standard rather than specially enhanced.

2.why: No italics, all-caps passages, or dense text blocks appear anywhere; headings use sentence case and all copy is broken into short lines.

3.why: Every screen is a single narrow column with large text, full-width inputs, and large buttons that fit a mobile viewport cleanly.

4.why: Instructions such as 'Sign in first. Then we will help you add your authenticator.' and 'Enter the 6 numbers when you are ready.' are short, plain sentences.

5.why: Expected input examples are shown as placeholders, e.g., 'Example: 123456' for the verification code and 'name@example.com' for the email field.

6.why: No screen contains more than one or two short sentences of instruction, so no long block of text must be read to proceed.

7.why: No copy-to-clipboard control appears on any screen, and the authenticator screen where a long secret or backup codes would appear is never reached (flow stalls at step 2).

8.why: No QR code or equivalent alternative to manual entry is visible in any screenshot, and the authenticator setup step where it would appear is absent/incomplete.

9.why: Standard labeled email, password, and code inputs are shown, but no explicit autofill or password-manager support can be confirmed or refuted from the screenshots.

10.why: Each screen shows a 'Step X of 4' banner at the top and one large blue primary button such as 'Sign in', 'Send code', or 'Check code'.

11.why: On the code-entry screens two primary-styled blue buttons ('Send code' and 'Check code') appear together alongside 'Send a new code', so more than one action competes visually.

12.why: After each action a banner plainly states the outcome and next step, e.g., 'Signed in. Next, check it is you.' and 'A code was sent. Enter the 6 numbers when you are ready.'

13.why: The 'Send a new code' button allows re-requesting and the error state permits retry without penalty, though no reveal/hide toggle for the password field is visible.

14.why: The observed error 'That code did not match. Check the 6 numbers or send a new code.' states the problem and the fix in neutral, non-blaming language.

15.why: No countdowns or timers appear on any screen and the copy repeatedly says 'when you are ready', indicating no reading or code-entry time pressure.
